test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 21 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The given sentence is in active voice. Change the voice of the sentence. Select the correct option from the sentences given in options.

She used the aerobic ball during workout.

options.text: During workout the aerobic ball were to be used by her.
During workout the aerobic ball will be used by her.
During workout the aerobic ball had been used by her.
During workout the aerobic ball was used by her.

solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 4'**
